cover_letter:
Dear Orac team,

I'm writing to apply for the Freelance Webmaster position at your Ostend HQ. Your need for someone to take immediate ownership of oracdecor.com and keep it running smoothly from day one is exactly the kind of focused, high-visibility assignment I thrive on.

In my current freelance work and as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage and maintain websites for clients across different sectors. I build and update pages in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math), troubleshoot issues, and ensure content and product data are accurate and published on time. For example, I'm currently building and maintaining a pharmacists' association site with a consistent layout for around 600 member profile pages, and I've built and optimized multi-page sites with structured data and technical SEO improvements that measurably raised search-health scores. I use Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs daily to spot issues, improve workflows and support conversion.

I'm comfortable jumping into an existing digital ecosystem quickly and working independently. I coordinate with marketing teams and clients on priorities and deadlines, and I'm used to managing tickets and status updates in tools like Jira. My background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and my hands-on coding skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) mean I can troubleshoot technical issues without always needing to escalate.

I'm available for a hybrid assignment in Ostend and can start immediately. I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can keep oracdecor.com technically healthy, content-accurate and user-friendly while your permanent search continues.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• Hands-on CMS experience: WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math), Shopify, WooCommerce – building, updating and troubleshooting pages.

• Content & product data accuracy: publishing and maintaining pages, blog posts, media and product catalogues for client websites.
• Coordination & workflow: working with marketing teams and clients on priorities and deadlines; familiar with Jira-style ticket management.
• Independent, detail-oriented and available immediately for a hybrid assignment in Ostend.
